entities.name: Convention on the Regulation of Antarctic Mineral Resource Activities
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Convention on the Regulation of Antarctic Mineral Resource Activities is an unratified treaty that is part of the Antarctic Treaty System. The convention was concluded at Wellington on 2 June 1988. The government of New Zealand is the depository of the treaty.
